text: The pipeline begins with the Input Images, processed via a 3D morphable model.
This establishes a 3D Proxy Model representing the base facial geometry.
In parallel, a surface Normal Map is generated to capture surface orientations.
Facial region Segmentation is also extracted across key feature zones.
Shadow Processing is then performed, resulting in Shadow Treatment on the input face.
Through Light Calibration and Photometric Stereo, the features combine into a Refined Model.
A Denoising stage then cleans the geometric mesh, yielding the Denoised Model.
Finally, the corresponding Albedo map is output alongside the denoised model.
